name: icpac-geonode-ethiopia-agro-biodiversity-dataset
notes: Gridded datasets used in Jones et al. (2021) paper 'Agrobiodiversity Index scores show agrobiodiversity is underutilized in national food systems'. Details of how datasets were made and underlying sources are provided in Jones et al. (2021) Supplementary Information - with a resolution of 0.05* 0.05 pixels approximately 5000 metres and referenced 2022
